scenicChapters.title: Dover White Cliffs → Folkestone coast
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 22 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

london-motorcycle-escapes-cambridge-fen-.story: A one-way ride of 832 km, Culverstone Green to Westerham - roughly 17 h 49 in the saddle. On the way it passes near Burnham-on-Crouch and Kidlington. The climbs: near Great Dunmow, Scenic stretch near Luton and near Hook. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Lahemaa Coastal Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 1 km this is Lahemaa Coastal Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

city-haapsalu-longday.story: From Haapsalu it runs 454 km to Haapsalu; allow about 7 h 50 of riding. The stops in between: Historic Centre, Fortress of Suomenlinna, back through Fortress of Suomenlinna and back through Historic Centre. It crosses from Estonia into Finland - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
